title: CrowdSec Metrics
description: Engine pipeline and central LAPI performance, with current native metric names and portable selectors.

options.content: Engine panels honor **Engine host**. Central API panels always use the LAPI job, even if an agent is selected. Rates use a scrape-safe interval; totals use the selected time range and are estimates. Quiet counter families may not exist until their first event: N/A is explicitly not a zero. Parser-node hits count traversal, not unique input lines.

panels.title: Parser unparsed lines per second
panels.description: Many benign application lines have no matching security parser. Investigate sustained unexpected changes, not every unparsed line.

panels.title: Allowlisted node matches — selected range
panels.description: Node-level match counts, not guaranteed unique lines or dropped requests.

panels.title: Parser-node nonmatches
panels.description: Nonmatches during parser traversal are expected; not parser exceptions.

panels.title: Canceled buckets — selected range
panels.description: May be absent until emitted. No series is not a healthy-zero assertion.

panels.title: LAPI p95 request latency
panels.description: A route without observations in the interval has no quantile, not zero latency.

panels.title: CPU — cores consumed
panels.description: One core = 1. Can exceed 1 for a multithreaded process.

panels.title: Nginx automatic update status
panels.description: Current native controller + independent watcher evidence. No change is a successful check, not a deployed upgrade. Same-pin acceptance is validation. In progress requires a running native service; stale evidence is not healthy.

panels.title: Pending nginx advisory reviews
panels.description: Unacknowledged advisory revisions, not CVE counts. An out-of-policy candidate also sets REVIEW NEEDED even when this is zero.

panels.title: Failed automatic transactions — rolling 24h
panels.description: Retained automatic journal outcomes: rejected preflight, incomplete recovery, or rollback. Excludes acceptance/rehearsal/audit. Failures before journaling are visible in current status, not this count.

panels.title: Production rollbacks — rolling 24h
panels.description: Retained automatic transactions with a changed candidate and completed rollback. Also included in failed transaction count; not additive. Incomplete rollback is RECOVERY REQUIRED, not completed rollback.
